subject: planner: Choose index with statistics vs one without (#58593)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent in planner only. Main behavior change is in skyline pruning: `compareCandidates` now prefers an index path that has analyzed statistics over one without (when both are non-IndexMerge index paths and the stats-backed index has >= equal/IN predicate count), to avoid inaccurate `CountAfterAccess` estimates from pruning the better-stats path (`pkg/planner/core/find_best_task.go`). Added regression test covers CREATE INDEX after ANALYZE (new index without stats should not beat an existing analyzed index unless it matches more equal predicates) (`pkg/planner/cardinality/selectivity_test.go`). No Blocker/High correctness/SQL-semantics/transaction/session/privilege issues found; the new stats-table access is consistent with existing invariants (skyline pruning already assumes stats are initialized via unguarded `ds.TableStats` usage).
